verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents date-based API versioning: clients pin a version by sending the implementation date in an `X-Version` header. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or a changelog, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, version lifecycle/sunset timelines, changelog or migration guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To lock down the API version, provide the current date at the time of implementation through `X-Version` header.
